|checkboxIsSub=No |checkbox-res=No |checkboxPrev=No }} ==Biography== == Trivia == * His signature picks are {{ci|Aphelios}}, {{ci|Kai'Sa}} and {{ci|Vladimir}}. * During his time on [[Griffin (Korean Team)|Griffin]], he was known for playing unusual mage picks such as {{ci|Viktor}} and {{ci|Taliyah}}, which he famously played in the [[LCK 2019 Spring Playoffs]]. ** He also played {{ci|Teemo}} twice and won with it, making him one of the few players to win with that pick on the professional stage. * Second player after [[imp]] to score a pentakill both in LCK and Worlds. * Fluent in Mandarin to the extent that he communicated with his teammates in [[EDward Gaming]] in Mandarin in-game after only one season after entering the LPL and gave interviews in Mandarin alone without an interpreter. * Speaks English well despite never playing in an English-speaking team, altough not as fluently as Mandarin * Chinese Valorant pro-gamer [https://liquipedia.net/valorant/ZmjjKK ZmjjKK] is a big fan of him. === Statistics === * Reached 1000 kills in the LCK on July 9th, 2023. ** Was the 24th player to reach 1000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Smeb]], [[Ambition]], [[Sangyoon]], [[Deft]], [[Teddy]], [[Ruler]], [[Bdd]], [[Ghost (Jang Yong-jun)|Ghost]], [[Peanut]], [[Chovy]], [[Fly (Song Yong-jun)|Fly]], [[ShowMaker]], [[Kiin]], [[Aiming]], [[Rascal]], [[deokdam]], [[Canyon]], and [[Cuzz]]. * Reached 1500 kills in the LCK on July 27th, 2024. ** Was the 15th player to reach 1500 kills after [[Faker]], [[PraY]], [[Bang]], [[Score]], [[Kuro]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[Peanut]], [[Aiming]], [[ShowMaker]], and [[Kiin]]. * Reached 2000 kills in the LCK on August 29th, 2025. ** Was the 10th player to reach 2000 kills in the LCK after [[Faker]], [[Deft]], [[Ruler]], [[Teddy]], [[Bdd]], [[Chovy]], [[Aiming]], [[ShowMaker]], and [[Peanut]]. * Reached 300 wins in the LCK on August 29th, 2025, becoming the 20th player to do so. * Reached 500 games in the LCK on August 15th, 2025, becoming the 22nd player to do so. === Individual Awards === * LPL MVP x1 (Spring 2021) * LPL Outstanding Rookie x1 (Spring 2021) * LPL 1st All-Pro Team x3 (Spring 2021, Summer 2021, Split 2 2026) * LPL 2nd All-Pro Team x3 (Spring 2022, Summer 2022, Split 1 2026) * LCK 2nd All-Pro Team x3 (Spring 2024, Summer 2024, LCK 2025) * LCK 3rd All-Pro Team x1 (Summer 2023) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}}
